_comment: Fallback alias table: in-game drop name -> the catalog entry it scores as.
The server sends an authoritative version of this in /api/plugin/config; this file only
fills gaps if the server's map is incomplete. Keys are matched after normalisation
(lowercase, charge-suffix stripped), so 'Scythe of Vitur (uncharged)' is listed without
its suffix. The 'raid' field is what disambiguates the two Kit/Dust catalog rows.
_ignoredComment: Raid loot that broadcasts like a purple but deliberately scores nothing. Listing them keeps
the debug log free of known noise, so an unmatched line there is a real surprise.
The ToA entries are an intentional event-rule asymmetry: CoX and ToB kits/dusts score 1,
ToA's upgrade items score 0 because the catalog has no ToA Kit/Dust row. Do not 'fix' this
without a matching drop_items row on the server.
